description: The chart displays three pie charts representing the distribution of categories across different difficulty levels, labeled as "easy", "medium", and an unlabeled third chart. Each pie chart is divided into four slices, corresponding to the categories N-K+, N-K-, N+K-, and an unlabeled category, colored in yellow, orange, red, and green, respectively. The "easy" chart shows the green slice at 55.4%, yellow at 38.3%, red at 1.7%, and orange at 4.6%. The "medium" chart has the green slice at 58.8%, yellow at 35.4%, red at 1.8%, and orange at 4.0%. The third chart displays the yellow slice at 37.9%, orange at 37.3%, red at 6.7%, and green at 18.1%. A legend on the right side of the image indicates the color coding for the categories. The percentage labels are shown inside each slice, and no slices are visually emphasized. The charts appear to be arranged in a sequence from left to right, with the first two labeled by difficulty level.
